```fun! CompleteMonths(findstart, base)
  if a:findstart
    " 単語の始点を検索する
    let line = getline('.')
    let start = col('.') - 1
    while start > 0 && line[start - 1] =~ '\a'
      let start -= 1
    endwhile
    return start
  else
    " "a:base" にマッチする月を探す
    let res = []
    for m in split("Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec")
      if m =~ '^' . a:base
        call add(res, m)
      endif
    endfor
    return res
  endif
endfun

func! EnableAutocomplete() abort
  setlocal completefunc=CompleteMonths
  augroup asyncomplete
    autocmd!
    autocmd TextChangedI <buffer> call feedkeys("\<C-x>\<C-u>")
  augroup END
endfunc```
